title: psychotria longifolia
intro: Psychotria longifolia, commonly known as Kola nut or Caffeine tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. The health benefits of Psychotria longifolia include its ability to act as a stimulant, improve mental clarity and focus, and aid in weight loss due to its high caffeine content. The plant has therapeutic actions that include central nervous system stimulation, bronchodilation, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Psychotria longifolia include caffeine, theobromine, theophylline, and other alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
